During a tactical action, when you produce 1 or more hits during a BOMBARDMENT roll: For each hit you produced, you may instead place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on the planet being bombarded.
Then, return this card to the L'tokk Khrask player.

name: Vassalage
text:
At the start of combat: Apply +1 to the results of each of your fighters' combat rolls during this combat.
The Kjalengard player captures each of your fighters destroyed during this combat.
Then, return this card to the Kjalengard player.

name: AI Survey
text:
At the start of your turn: You may look at either the top card of the cultural, hazardous, and industrial exploration decks, or the top card of the relic deck.
Then, return this card to the Kollecc player.

name: Combinatorial Bypass
text:
At the start of invasion, place this card in your play area.
During this invasion, all other player's units lose SPACE CANNON and PLANETARY SHIELD.
At the start of your next turn, return this card to the Kolume player.

name: Blessing of the Queens
text:
ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area and remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board.
At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Kortali player.

name: Kyro Rider
text:
After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on a planet you control.
Then, return this card to the Kyro player.

name: Spoils of War
text:
After you win a combat: Place this card face-up in your play area to explore 1 planet you control.
At the start of the Lanefir player's turn, return this card to the Lanefir player.

name: Trusted Counselor
text:
At the start of a space combat you are participating in: You may place up to 2 fighters from your reinforcements into the space area of the active system.
Then, return this card to the Li-Zho player.

name: Rapid Excavation
text:
At the start of your turn: You may move up to 2 PDS units you control to a planet you control.
Then, return this card to the Mirveda player.

name: Secrets of the Weave
text:
At the start of a space combat while you are the defender: You may spend influence equal to the cost value of 1 of your opponent's ships in the active system to place 1 unit of that type from your reinforcements in that system.
Then, return this card to the Mortheus player.

name: Gift of Insight
text:
ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area.While this card is in your play area, once per turn, after you roll a die, you may reroll that die.
If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Myko-Mentori player's units, return this card to the Myko-Mentori player.

name: Nivyn Guidance
text:
After you activate a system: During this activation, you may ignore the effects of each anomaly.
Return this card to the Nivyn player at the end of this activation.

name: Nokar Navigator
text:
At the start of a space combat: During this combat, the active system is adjacent to each system that contains a planet you control for the purposes of announcing and resolving retreats.
At the end of this combat, return this card to the Nokar player.

name: Incite Revolution
text:
ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area to choose and exhaust 1 planet you control. Then, ready 1 non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex.
At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Olradin player.

name: Death Binding
text: When the Pharad'n player passes, remove 4 of your infantry from the game board to gain 1 technology with no prerequisites. Then, return this card to the Pharad'n player; that player captures 1 infantry from the supply.

name: Alloy Shipments
text: At the start of a round of combat: Choose up to 3 of your units; during this round of combat, hits those units produce cannot be canceled. After this round of combat, return this card to the Qhet player.

name: Favor of Rhodun
text:
When you ignore a prerequisite on a technology card you are researching: You may ignore 1 additional prerequisite of the same color.
Then, return this card to the Rhodun player.

name: Automatons
text:
At the end of your turn, you may attach this card to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex.
This planet has PRODUCTION 3 as if it were a unit.

name: Plots Within Plots
text:
When you draw 1 or more secret objective cards: Draw 1 additional secret objective card. Then, return 1 secret objective card to the secret objective deck. Shuffle that deck.
Then, return this card to the Tnelis player.

name: Concordat Allegiant
text: ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area. Once per action, when you win a combat against a player with more victory points than you, gain 3 commodities. You must spend 1 token from your fleet pool and return this card to the Toldar player to activate a system that contains that player's units.

name: Eerie Predictions
text:
At the start of the status phase: You may look at the top card of any 1 deck; place that card on the top or bottom of that deck. 
Then, return this card to the Uydai player.

name: Vaden Handshake
text:
After you activate a system: You may spend any number of trade goods. For each trade good spent, apply +1 to the move value of 1 non-fighter ship you control during this activation.
Return this card to the Vaden player at the end of this activation.

name: Clan's Favor
text:
At the start of a round of space combat: The Vaylerian player discards 1 action card. Then, move all of your ships from the active system to an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw.
Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system and return this card to the Vaylerian player.

name: Branch Office - Tax Haven
text:
When you receive this card, you must attach it to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not have a Branch Office attachment.
Its influence value is increased by 1.

name: Branch Office - Broadcast Hub
text:
When you receive this card, you must attach it to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not have a Branch Office attachment.
Its influence value is increased by 1.

name: Branch Office - Reserve Bank
text:
When you receive this card, you must attach it to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not have a Branch Office attachment.
Its resource value is increased by 1.

name: Branch Office - Orbital Shipyard
text:
When you receive this card, you must attach it to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex that does not have a Branch Office attachment.
Its resource value is increased by 1.

name: Hyperkinetic Ordinance
text:
When 1 or more of your units would make a BOMBARDMENT roll: If you produce 1 or more hits during this BOMBARDMENT roll, produce 1 additional hit for that roll.
Then, return this card to the Zelian player.

name: Echo PN
text: Variable.

name: Political Favor
text: When an agenda is revealed: Remove 1 token from the Xxcha player's strategy pool and return it to their reinforcements. Then, discard the revealed agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead. Then, return this card to the Xxcha player.

name: Fires of the Gashlai
text: ACTION: Remove 1 token from the Muaat player's fleet pool and return it to their reinforcements. Then, gain your war sun unit upgrade technology card.  Then, return this card to the Muaat Player.

name: Pull the Thread
text: If you are not the Araenean player, you may reveal this card and choose a system that contains a weaveway token and none of your units. If you do, move that token into an adjacent system that contains 1 or more of your ships. Then, return this card to the Araenean player.

name: Transit Indulgence
text: When you activate a system, place this card face up in your play area. While this card is in your area, you are not an outlaw. Return a decree to the Xxcha player and return their command token from your faction sheet. At the end of your turn, return this card to the Xxcha player.

name: Mental Clarity
text: After another player moves ships into a system that contains your units; you may reveal this card and choose ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE, SPACE CANNON, BOMBARDMENT, SUSTAIN DAMAGE or PRODUCTION. Other players cannot use that unit ability in this system this turn. At the end of the turn, return this card to the Neurovoid player.

name: Eyes of the Watcher
text: When another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your infantry: for each adjacent system, you may move one of your non-fighter shups in that system into the active system. Then, return this card to the Convocation player

name: Dirzuga Reinforcements
text: When you produce units: place a Dizurga token onto either a planet that has a unit with production or 3 infantry you control. Then, return this card to the Arborec Diaspora player.

name: Cortical Backup
text: ACTION: place this card in your play area. During your tactical actions, you may treat non-fighter neutral ships as if they were your own. If you move neutral units or activate a system that contains 1 or more of the H4L1R's player's units, return this card to the H4L1R player.

name: Authorization Warrant
text: When you recieve this card, if you are not the Keleres Player, you must place it face up in your play area. At the end of the status phase, draw 1 secret obkectove, place it face up in your play area, then return this card to the Keleres player.

name: Eramina Elixer
text: When you would research a technology; you may reveal this card and gain 1 random genome instead. Then, retrun this card to the Moyin player.

name: Covert Channel
text: At any time: you may discard any number of action cards. For each action card discarded, you gain 1 commodity. Then, convert all commodities to trade goods. At the end of this turn, return this card to the Veilstrike player.

name: Gift of Prescience
text: At the end of the Strategy Phase: Place this card faceup in your play area and place the Naalu '0' token on your strategy card, you are the first in initiative order. The Naalu player cannot use their Telepathic faction ability during this game round. Return this card to the Naalu player at the end of the status phase.

name: Greyfire Mutagen
text: At the start of a ground combat against 2 or more ground forces that are not controlled by the Yin player: Replace 1 of your opponent's infantry with 1 infantry from your reinforcements. Then, return this card to the Yin player.

name: Toksoto Strike
text: During the first round of space combat, you may play this card before combat dice are rolled to produce one hit against your opponent. They must assign it immediately. Then, return this card to the Hissho player. They gain one Keii.

name: Borrowed Ingenuity
text: When researching a unit upgrade technology: You may return this card to the Horatio player to ignore one prerequisite.

name: Creuss Iff
text: At the start of your turn during the action phase: Place or move a Creuss wormhole token into either a system that contains a planet you control or a non-home system that does not contain another player's ships. Then, return this card to the Creuss player.

name: Shadow Banking
text: When the Lumeris player performs a strategic action: Play this card and give three trade goods to the Lumeris player to use the secondary ability of their strategy card without spending a command token. At the end of that strategic action, return this card to the Lumeris player.

name: Infestation
text: During ground combat, after one of your opponent's units is destroyed: You may place up to 2 infantry on that planet. Then, return this card to the Arachnera player.

name: Rokawowk
text: When a player would explore a planet: Instead of exploring that planet, explore that planet 2 times. Then place this card face up in your play area. Return this card to the The Outer Planet Alliance player at the start of the status phase.

name: Plea Deal
text: Before you would perform an action on your turn: You may place this card face up in your play area. Until the end of this turn, treat this card as if it were a copy of a technology card that the PSM player controls. Return this card to the PSM player at the start of the status phase.

name: Antivirus
text: ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area. While this card is in your play area, the Nekro player cannot use their Technological Singularity faction ability against you. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Nekro player's units, return this card to the Nekro player.

name: Cybernetic Enhancements
text: When the Primary ability of Leadership is resolved: You may spend 2 influence to gain command tokens instead of 3 influence this round. Then, return this card to the L1Z1X player.

name: Political Favor
text: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, you may produce 1 ship in any system that contains 1 or more of your space docks. Then, return this card to the Xxcha player.

name: Greyfire Mutagen
text: At the start of a ground combat against a player other than the Yin: Roll 1 die for each enemy ground force on that planet. For each result of 8-10, destroy that ground force. Then, return this card to the Yin player.

name: Creuss Iff
text: After you activate a system: During this tactical action, systems that contain non-delta wormholes are adjacent to each other. Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships that starts its movement in your home system or in a system that contains a non-delta wormhole. Then, return this card to the Creuss player.

name: Military Support
text: At the start of the Sol player's turn: You may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control. Then, return this card to the Sol player.

name: Stymie
text: At the start of a combat against a player other than the Arborec: Your opponent cannot make combat rolls during this combat round. Then, return this card to the Arborec player.

name: Tekklar Legion
text: At the start of a ground combat against a player other than the N'orr: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat. Then, return this card to the N'orr player.

name: War Funding
text: At the start of a round of space combat: During this combat round, reroll any number of your dice. Then, return this card to the Letnev player.

name: Military Support
text: At the start of the Sol player's turn: Remove 1 token from the Sol player's strategy pool, if able, and return it to their reinforcements. Then, you may place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control. Then, return this card to the Sol player.

name: Tribute and Supplication
text: During your turn, you may give this card and a relic fragment to the Nakalim player to draw an action card.

name: Nano-Link Permit
text: After you activate a system: You may move your structures from adjacent systems that do not contain your command tokens onto planets you control in the active system. Then, return this card to the Ral Nel player.

name: Netharii PN
text: Play at the start of combat. Once during this combat, when a unit is destroyed, you may place it on your home system instead. At the end of the combat, return this card to the Netharii Keepers player.

name: Networking Officer
text: This promissory note has the ability text of 1 of your faction promissory notes of your choice, replacing any reference to your faction with that of the Drahn player.

name: Diplomatic Base
text: When you recive this card you must immediatly attach this card to 1 non-home planet you control. Its Influence value is increses by 3. This planet may not have more then 3 infantry and 1 mech of each player. Excess units on this planet are returned to the space area. This planet may be traded as part of a transaction.

name: Wealth Agreement
text: When the Er'ock player replensishes commodidtes, gain trade goods equal to their commodity value.

name: Unified Exploration
text: Action: place this card in your play area. While this card is in your play area after the Explantaery allience or you explore a planet you each gain 1 trade good or 2 comodities. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the allience units return this card to the allience player.

name: Antivirus
text: ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area. While this card is in your play area, the Nekro player cannot use their Technological Singularity faction ability against you. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Nekro player's units, return this card to the Nekro Player.

name: Greyfire Mutagen
text: At the start of a ground combat against a player other than the Yin player: Roll 1 die for each enemy infantry on that planet. For each result of 8 or higher, destroy that infantry. Then, return this card to the Yin Player.

name: Creuss Iff
text: After you activate a system: You may place a Creuss wormhole token in any system that contain your ships. During this tacticle action, systems that contain non-delta wormholes are adjacent to each other. Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships that moves through one or more wormholes. Then, return this card to the Creuss player.

name: Military Support
text: At the start of the Sol player's turn, if their strategy card is exhausted: You may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control. Then, return this card to the Sol Player.

name: Political Favor
text: After and agenda is revealed: You may play this card to vote with the resource values of your planets instead of the influence value during this agenda. After resolveing the agenda, if you vote for the same outcome as the Xxcha player, and that outcome is resolved, both you and the Xxcha player may ready all of your planets; return this card to the Xxcha player.

name: Stymie
text: At the start of a combat against a player other than the Arborec player: Your opponent cannont make combat rolls during this combat round. Then, return this card to the Arborec Player.

name: Tekklar Legion
text: At the start of a ground combat against any player other than the N'orr player: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat. Then, return this card to the N'orr player.

name: War Funding
text: At the start of a round of spce combat: During this combat round, reroll any number of your dice. then, return this card to the letnev player.

name: Promise of Protection
text: ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area. While this card is in your play area, the Mentak player cannot use their Pillage faction ability against you. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Mentak player's units, return this card to the Mentak player.

name: Research Agreement
text: After the Jol-Nar player researches a technology that is not a faction technology: Gain that technology. Then, return this card to the Jol-Nar player.

name: Raghs Call
text: After you commit 1 or more units to land on a planet: Remove all of the Saar player's ground forces from that planet and place them on a planet controlled by the Saar player. Then, return this card to the Saar player.

name: Raise the Standard
text: At the end of a combat: Galvanize 1 of your units that participated. Then, return this card to the Last Bastion player.

name: Keleres Rider
text: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 1 action card and gain 2 trade goods. Then, return this card to the Keleres player.

text: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 1 action card and gain 2 trade goods. Then, return this card to the Keleres player.

name: Keleres Rider
text: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 1 action card and gain 2 trade goods. Then, return this card to the Keleres player.

name: Student of the Expedition
text: When you receive this card, if you are not the Riftborn player, immediately place it into your play area. Whenever you activate a system that contains one of the Riftborn's units, return this card to the Riftborn player. Whenever the Riftborn uses their Masters of Space and Time ability, you may ready any one technology you control.

name: Scepter of Dominion
text: At the start of the strategy phase: Choose 1 non-home system that contains your units, each other player who has a token on the Mahact player's command sheet places a token from their reinforcements in that system. Then, return this card to the Mahact player.

name: Sever
text: ACTION: place this card face up in your play area, and place the sever token in a system that contains your units, wormholes in that system have no effect during movement. Remove the sever token and return this card to the Rebellion player at end of the status phase.

name: Share Knowledge
text: ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area and gain 1 non-faction, non-unit upgrade technology that the Deepwrought player owns; place that technology on this card. Return that technology to the deck and this card to the Deepwrought player at the end of the status phase.

name: Experimental Extravaganza
text: At the start of the Status Phase, choose a non-faction technology the Sophon player owns. When you do, remove a command token from your fleet pool for each prerequisite you do not meet. Then gain that technology and return this card to the Sophon player.

name: Spy Net
text: At the start of your turn: Look at the Yssaril player's hand of action cards. Choose 1 of those cards and add it to your hand. Then, return this card to the Yssaril player.

name: Star Wars
text: After an opponent moves ships into a system that contains your units, you may fire SPACE CANNON 5(x3), then return this card.

name: Strotemarket
text: At the start of your turn, you may spend 1 resource to place 1 destroyer or 2 fighters in a system that does not contain another player's ships. Then, return this card to the Raven player.

name: Stymie
text: After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 or more of your units: You may place 1 command token from that player's reinforcements in any non-home system. Then, return this card to the Arborec player.

name: Tekklar Legion
text: At the start of an invasion combat: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat. If your opponent is the N'orr player, apply -1 to the result of each of their unit's combat rolls during this combat. Then, return this card to the N'orr player.

name: Terraform
text: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-home planet you control other than Mecatol Rex. Its resource and influence values are each increased by 1, and it is treated as having all 3 planet traits (cultural, hazardous, and industrial).

name: Funeral Services
text: At the start of a round of combat, place this card face up in your play area: Each time a fighter is destroyed during this combat roll a dice, for each result greater than 5 place that fighter on this card. At the start of your next turn place each fighter in systems that contain your ships. Then, return this card to the Aeterna player.

name: Scroll of Ascension
text: At the start of the strategy phase: Research 1 non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology the Arcanum player does not own. If you do, the Arcanum player may spend 1 command token from their strategy pool to gain that technology. Then, return this card to the Arcanum player.

name: The Usurper's Lease
text: When you would spend influence to gain 1 or more command tokens: Increase the amount of influence spent by the number of neighbors you have. Then, return this card to the Ardentia player.

name: Archaeological Outpost
text: ACTION: Attach this card to 1 non-home planet. When you activate this planet's system, explore it.

name: Evolutionary Edict
text: When you research a unit upgrade: Produce 1 of those units in your home system. Reduce its cost by the number of its prerequisites. Then, return this card to the Kryxos player.

name: Factory Lease: Cultural
text: At the end of your turn, attach this card to a cultural planet you control: That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its influence value.

name: Factory Lease: Hazardous
text: At the end of your turn, attach this card to a hazardous planet you control: That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its resource value.

name: Factory Lease: Industrial
text: At the end of your turn, attach this card to an industrial planet you conrol: That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to the number of planets in that system.

name: Shard of Nothingness
text: ACTION: Draw 3 unused red-backed tiles. Choose 1 and place it adjacent to 2 systems. If it contains no planets, place a frontier token in that system. Then, purge this card and the unchosen tiles.

name: Thunderbird Prototype
text: At the start of space combat select 1 of your ground forces in that system: That unit participates in combat as if it were a ship and you may treat them as Galvanized until the end of the combat. Return this card to the Ponthous player at the end of that combat.

name: Revenant Alliance
text: When you receive this card and you are not the Revenant Glory player, place it face up in your play area: While this is in your play area, you can use the Revenant Glory player's Pantheon commander ability if it is unlocked. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Revenant player's units, return this card to the Revenant player.

name: Thronebound Covenant
text: ACTION: Place an unused throne planet into your home system and gain control of it. Then, purge this promissory note.

name: Pact Renewed
text: When you perform the primary effect of a strategy card, you may place this card face up in your play area: Perform the secondary effect of that strategy card without spending a command token. At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Verydith player.

name: Hand of the Synod
text: ACTION: Discard up to 1 action card and draw that many action cards + 1. At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Veylor player.

name: Swarm Spawn
text: When you produce hits with a unit ability against your opponent's units, place this card face up in your play area. You may place fighters in a system contianing 1 of your ships equal to the number of hits produced. Then, return this card to the Xytheris player.

name: Euphonic Ensemble
text: ACTION: Gain a command token, then place this card face-up in your play area. Whenever the Umbral Choir player would place the 9 token on their Strategy Card while this card is in your play area, return this card to the Umbral Choir player and place the 9 token on your Strategy Card instead. You are last in initiative order.

name: The Emperor's Voice
text: When you receive this promissory note, if it is the Agenda Phase, return this card to the United Empire player. Otherwise, place it face-up in your play area. During the Agenda phase, you always vote after the United Empire player. When you vote, you may add an additional vote for each Command Token on your faction sheet. If you vote for an outcome to an agenda that the United Empire player did not vote for or predict, return this card to the United Empire player.

name: Organic Sentinels
text: ACTION: Remove a Command Token from your faction sheet to place a PDS on any planet you control in an Entangled system. Then, return this card to the Unfallen player.

name: Vaulter Planetary Synchronization
text: When you receive this promissory note, if you are not the Vaulter player, place it face-up into your play area. This card has the text of all legendary planet cards you control while it is in your play area, except for A Song like Marrow. After you pass, if this card is exhausted, return it to the Vaulter player.

name: Benevolent Conversion
text: ACTION: Remove all of your infantry from a planet that is in the same system or in a system adjacent to a planet the Vodyani player controls. For each unit returned to your reinforcements in this way, gain a trade good. Then, return this card to the Vodyani player.

name: War Funding

name: Stringwalk Teachings
